author: MintPlayer
name: Spark custom action
description: A custom action on a Spark model type. Run it in the app's project directory; it writes CustomActions/<name>Action.cs. Its doc comment holds the actions.json entry and the security.json right it needs.

entity.description: The entity the action works on, e.g. Invoice.

namespace.description: The project's root namespace. Defaults to the RootNamespace of the project in or above the output directory.
